tagline: Full-Stack Engineer **// 8 years** shipping backend + frontend systems — from real-time C media daemons to configurable UI engines.

paragraphs: **Full-stack engineer with 8 years in the game.** I build robust backend services in Node.js and Java, tuned for scalability, reliability and security — and I bring the same care to the frontend.

Lately I've been deep in a Linux C daemon that orchestrates real-time media across multi-display walls, wiring PipeWire audio routing over D-Bus and WebSocket JSON-RPC. Before that: modular monorepos, configurable layout + rule engines, and a GraphQL-to-everything transpiler.
I take pride in problem-solving and shipping — and I've been recognized with a **Champion Award** for project contribution.
